order: Add a narrow carve-out to the guard hook so the Director can write its own plan files directly instead of routing every plan write through an executor. Scope it precisely: allow write and edit operations only for markdown files under the project's designated plans directory, resolving the target path and verifying containment so a parent-directory traversal cannot escape it, and requiring the .md extension so the carve-out cannot be used to smuggle arbitrary code writes. Let projects extend the allowed locations via a new config key of path-pattern regexes, additive to the default directory, matched against the forward-slash project-relative path, and never allowed to match outside the project; parse it with the same fail-open rules as the existing config keys. Update the default deny message for file-writing tools to name this exception so a blocked Director can see where plans may go, and update the docs and installer notes to match.
claims: Verified with a 19-case smoke harness: the default carve-out for nested and relative paths and for each write operation, denial of non-markdown and traversal attempts, presence and absence of the deny hint, the pause file left unaffected, model stand-down behavior, allow/deny/outside-project handling for the pattern config, and fail-safe behavior on a broken config. Docs and installer notes were updated to match.
